entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yes! We can finally play games now![n]I was really looking forward to this.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Although it's a game, you can sharpen[n]your senses if you focus. You just might[n]benefit from it.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So, what do you want to play?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right! What do you want to play?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, you don't have any games[n]we can play...
I already beat all the games I have.[n]I should do something else for now.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Wait... Didn't you already beat that one?[n]You still want to play it?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Star Forneus is a vertical scrolling[n]shoot 'em up.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The trick is in the rapid-fire technique.[n]Shoot as fast as you can, and watch out[n]for enemies!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Throw yourself into the heat of battle,[n]and you'll have more [stIcon 3][clr 26][stLabel 3][clr 27][n]than you did before... Maybe.
